title.zh: 黄仁勋辞去英伟达 CEO，Colette Kress 任临时 CEO
title.en: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; Colette Kress named interim CEO

summary.zh: 黄仁勋在执掌英伟达 33 年后辞职，Colette Kress 接任临时 CEO。多家媒体称此事涉及国家安全议题；亚洲多国政府已就芯片供应作出回应，VC 预计 AI 创业融资将收紧。
summary.en: Huang resigned after 33 years leading Nvidia, and Colette Kress is interim CEO. Outlets tie the saga to national-security concerns; Asian governments reacted over chip supply and VCs expect tighter AI startup funding.

why.zh: AI 算力龙头换帅，波及供应链与融资环境。
why.en: The leadership change at the AI compute leader ripples through supply and funding.

sources.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline

Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say

summary.en: ChatGPT Wallet lets agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex and dots complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections. It starts with US Pro subscribers and replaces the earlier Instant Checkout approach.

why.zh: Agent 开始具备真实支付能力。
why.en: Agents are gaining real payment ability.

title.zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 登顶 MathArena，但成本是 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 15 倍
title.en: Gemini 4 Carbon tops MathArena at 15x the cost of GPT-6.1 Sol

summary.zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 与 Anthropic 的 Fable 5.2 超过 OpenAI 模型，登上 MathArena 数学榜首，但价格远高于 GPT-6.1 Sol。
summary.en: Gemini 4 Carbon and Anthropic's Fable 5.2 knocked OpenAI off the top of the MathArena math benchmark, at far higher cost than GPT-6.1 Sol.

why.zh: 数学推理榜单易主，性价比出现分化。
why.en: Math leadership changes hands, with a cost gap.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol

title.zh: OpenAI 再次解散独立机器人团队
title.en: OpenAI dissolves its standalone robotics team again

summary.zh: OpenAI 把机器人研究员调往其他团队，称并非缺数据，而是 GPT-6 Astra 等通用模型可能让专用机器人 AI 变得不必要。
summary.en: OpenAI is reassigning robotics researchers; the reason is not lack of data but that general models like GPT-6 Astra may make specialized robotics AI unnecessary.

why.zh: 反映通用模型路线对专用方案的挤压。
why.en: Shows general models squeezing out specialized approaches.

sources.title: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary

title.zh: LangChain 估值达 30 亿美元

summary.zh: LangChain 称 LangSmith 已有 7000 家客户，估值达到 30 亿美元。
summary.en: LangChain says LangSmith has 7,000 customers and is now valued at $3B.

why.zh: Agent 工程平台的资本热度。
why.en: A sign of capital flowing into agent tooling.

sources.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
